verdict.rationale: A desktop client is a fair axis for an authenticator and password vault, but the evidence describes only a mobile app: App Store download, phone approvals, and mobile backup. Typing a code shown in Authenticator into a sign-in page on a remote screen is not a desktop app delivering codes or vault access. No documented desktop surface exists.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
